# Kiyo Compass — Traceability

Snapshot: Prompt 18 (Memory Skill), 2026-09-29. Requirement registration is not product
implementation. Read full criteria in [REQUIREMENTS.md](REQUIREMENTS.md).

Implementation statuses: NOT_IMPLEMENTED, PARTIALLY_IMPLEMENTED, IMPLEMENTED.
Verification statuses for checks: PASS, FAIL, NOT_RUN, NOT_APPLICABLE, BLOCKED.
All full requirement verifications are NOT_RUN. Prompt 02 documentation checks
validate research records, not native packages or behavior. Partial documentation
implementation is identified below; shared Core/Memory/governance/security/flows are authored, while later
procedures, public skills, native packages and final-gap audit remain pending.
Prompt 03 architecture is design evidence only, not implemented product behavior.
Its document checks do not promote any full requirement verification or live result.
Prompt 04 adds partial product Markdown instruction coverage; static Core checks
are separate from unexecuted expected-response scenarios and live-host evidence.
Prompt 05 adds Memory specification/templates/procedures and NOT_RUN scenario
specifications. Static document checks are not behavioral or native-host results.
Prompt 06 adds governance policy text and NOT_RUN decision examples, not policy
engine/native permission enforcement or completed scenario evaluation.
Prompt 09 adds six standards, four optional profiles/extension contract and a dated
concept-to-rule/evidence mapping. Sixteen synthetic scenarios are NOT_RUN.
Prompt 10 adds shared evidence/DoD/reporting contracts and seven neutral templates;
20 synthetic good/bad cases remain NOT_RUN. Public skills and native/stack
behavior remain unverified; static checks do not satisfy full acceptance.
Prompt 11 adds the first canonical Init entry and shared resources. Bounded source
forward trials have their own fixture/method/limitations record; they do not promote
full Init acceptance, all scenarios or any native target. Seven skills remain pending. Live target state uses NOT_TESTED until actually tested.

Implementing Files lists actual implementation only. Proposed locations are in
the linked registry entries. TC-REQ-NNN means a **reserved planned identifier**;
no corresponding product test file or execution is claimed. An empty evidence
cell is shown as “—”, never as a passing result.

“All six” means the six targets individually listed in [BASELINE.md](BASELINE.md#target-baseline);
it is a scope label, not a compatibility assertion. Shared behavioral results do
not establish native host compatibility.

Prompt 07 adds AST01–AST10 controls, shared security reviews, optional templates
and a six-target control-gap matrix. Nineteen scenario specifications remain
NOT_RUN. OWASP source revalidation and static checks do not verify host behavior.

Prompt 08 adds the Markdown Router and adaptive/implementation/read-only/repair
flows, with 30 routing rows and nine flow scenarios (NOT_RUN). Catalog names and
static routing specifications are not installed public skills or native activation.

Prompt 14 adds canonical Review, one shared procedure/control, a severity/confidence
guide and bounded report template, and refines finding fields. Sixteen specifications
remain NOT_RUN as a full matrix; bounded source-guided trials and resource checks
are recorded separately. REQ-071 is newly partial: 70 PARTIALLY_IMPLEMENTED /
10 NOT_IMPLEMENTED. Four public skills/native artifacts remain pending.
All 80 full requirement verifications remain NOT_RUN.

Prompt 15 adds canonical Test, a shared procedure/control, assess/run/write
mode/safety matrix and neutral test plan/report templates. Eighteen specifications
remain NOT_RUN as a full matrix; bounded source trials and resource validation
are separate evidence. REQ-072 is newly partial: 71 PARTIALLY_IMPLEMENTED /
9 NOT_IMPLEMENTED. Three public skills/native artifacts remain pending.
All 80 full requirement verifications remain NOT_RUN.

Prompt 16 adds canonical Security with four logical submodes under one entry,

templates. Eighteen specifications remain NOT_RUN as a full matrix. Source trials
and portability checks do not verify native enforcement or complete AST compliance.
REQ-073 is newly partial: 72 PARTIALLY_IMPLEMENTED / 8 NOT_IMPLEMENTED.
Architecture and Memory public entries remain pending; all 80 full verifications
remain NOT_RUN.

Prompt 17 adds canonical Architecture, its shared procedure/control, observation
and impact templates and extended shared drift report. Sixteen specifications
remain NOT_RUN as a complete matrix; bounded read-only source trials and resource
checks are separate. REQ-074 newly partial: 73 PARTIALLY_IMPLEMENTED /
7 NOT_IMPLEMENTED. Memory is the remaining public entry; all 80 full requirement
verifications remain NOT_RUN.

Prompt 18 adds canonical Memory with show/check/sync/repair effects, mode guidance
and three neutral delta/sync/repair reports using the existing lifecycle.
Eighteen additional specifications remain NOT_RUN as a complete matrix.
All eight canonical public entries now exist, without extra shared-procedure

All 80 full requirement verifications remain NOT_RUN.
